title: Activity Web App
shortDescription: Activity Web App is a full-stack activity tracking application built with a React and TypeScript front end and an ASP.NET Core Web API backend. It explores authenticated CRUD workflows, RESTful API design, and persistent user-specific data using ASP.NET Core Identity and SQLite.
overview: A full-stack web application that allows authenticated users to create, view, update, and manage activities through a React interface backed by an ASP.NET Core REST API and SQLite database.
problem: I wanted to build a complete full-stack application that went beyond a standalone frontend or API, demonstrating how authentication, persistent data, client-server communication, and user-scoped CRUD operations fit together in a modern web application.
solution: I developed a React and TypeScript frontend that communicates with an ASP.NET Core Web API through REST endpoints. ASP.NET Core Identity manages user registration and authentication, while application and user data are persisted with SQLite. The backend exposes authenticated CRUD operations so activity data can be securely created, retrieved, updated, and deleted through the frontend.
outcome: The project demonstrates an end-to-end full-stack architecture, covering frontend state and user interaction, REST API development, authentication and authorization, relational data persistence, and secure communication between independently structured client and server applications.
highlights: Built a full-stack application using React and TypeScript with an ASP.NET Core Web API backend
Implemented user registration and authentication with ASP.NET Core Identity
Designed RESTful endpoints supporting authenticated CRUD operations for activity data
Persisted application and identity data using SQLite
Separated frontend and backend responsibilities through a client-server architecture
